definitions.gloss: route map; transit map; network map
definitions.explanation: A diagram showing the routes of trains, buses, or other transportation lines. Especially common for railway and subway systems in Japan.

examples.japanese: {路線図|ろせんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I look at the route map.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{路線図|ろせんず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換え：16130_norikae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the transfer on the route map at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{路線図|ろせんず}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧で、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧しまう。
examples.english: Tokyo's subway route map is so complicated that you get confused when you see it for the first time.

notes:
USAGE: {路線図|ろせんず} is commonly found at train stations and bus stops throughout Japan. It shows the network of lines with station names and connection points.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路線図|ろせんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at a route map
- ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{路線図|ろせんず}: subway route map
- ⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧{路線図|ろせんず}: railway network map
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧{路線図|ろせんず}: bus route map

The word is a compound of ⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧ (route, line) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, map).
